Questions

How much do projects in AI integration and agents cost?
An MVP in this group costs $2,000–22,000 (UZS 24–265 mln), a full version up to $80,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 2–12 weeks, a full version 6–30 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Sample data: questions, documents or chats; answer rules and topics to avoid; a person who checks the results.
